mapper.select: SELECT k.chapter_id AS chapterId, k.source_path AS sourcePath, MIN(k.title) AS title FROM knowledge_chunks k JOIN chapters c ON c.id = k.chapter_id WHERE (k.source_path LIKE 'textbook/%' OR k.source_path LIKE 'courseware/%') AND k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND k.resource_id IS NULL AND k.license_scope IN ('PUBLIC','CLASSROOM_ONLY') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY k.chapter_id, k.source_path ORDER BY k.source_path
